task: round 14 RE-CHECK OLD CONCLUSIONS (3 closed/rejected ideas vs new facts)
summary: Round 14 recheck (27 Sep 01:48-02:25Z). The desk-only re-read used CONTEXT, RESULTS, the IDEAS ledger, exp60 results.md and the x138 notebook. There were no Kaggle calls, no Chrome, no build, no submit and no commit. The 36 items rechecked in rounds 2-13 and the closed list in the task were excluded. Three picks follow. (A) I-106, the exp23 secondary with the PUBLIC primary ('never run; family closed after 4 negatives'). The '0/5 model-swap record' quoted for exp72 (CONTEXT 21:21Z; reach0955 v_retrain) is confounded. 2 of the 5 are primary swaps. All 3 secondary swaps ran on an exp03B primary, which the 11 Sep entry itself flagged as correlated errors. exp72 (x138 public primary + distilled FT secondary) is exactly the never-tested I-106 class. The nearest datum stays exp32 at -0.007, lab-reproduced but on the exp03B base. The prior should be framed as 'one confounded precedent', not '0/5', in the 07:30Z Q1-Q3 push. No gate or pair rule changes. (B) I-063, DaughterNet v2 / v1+v2 average: the verdict 'insertion worse than v1' came from SELECTION differences of 1-4 division events, which the same CONTEXT entry calls noise. v2's honest pool AUC was higher (0.875 vs 0.825). The reason is corrected to 'undecided'. The idea stays closed for 29 Sep because of R8, the threshold re-calibration it would need (a knob), class C, and the fact that v1 is the only publicly proven insertion config. It moves to the post-deadline list. (C) I-069, D1 OOF insertion rescore: the GPU run stays refuted, because an honest per-embryo answer already sits in the record. It is v1 OOF on the old base: CONFIRMATION +0.0019, 44b6 +0.0015, 6bba +0.0021, added precision 4/15 = 0.27, Wilson 80% [0.15, 0.43] against a low-J break-even of 0.11-0.20. R12-A3's 'insertion lab +0.006' is the exp60 IN-SAMPLE upper bound (added precision 0.57, about 2x the honest value). P(<0 on private) 0.10-0.15 survives, perhaps widened to 0.10-0.20. The pair rule ({#37, #38} = insertion hedge) is reinforced, not changed. The three public +0.001 insertion reads, and 3 of the 4 E contrasts in R12-A9(e), are one mechanism, so they are not independent evidence. Finals #37 + #38, L9, L5v2 and R8 are untouched.

findings.what:
I-063: DaughterNet v2 (v1 + 11,117 hard pool rows) and the v1+v2 average for the insertion.

OLD VERDICT: refuted, 'Pool AUC better (0.875) but insertion worse than v1 on SELECTION; v1+v2 average not better' (IDEAS I-063).

RE-READ OF THE EVIDENCE (CONTEXT 24 Sep 01:30-03:10Z, l.1314-1327):
- The same entry that made the call says 'All L2 deltas on 64 videos are 1-4 division events, i.e. inside noise'. The SELECTION numbers were v2 orphan +0.0010 vs v1 +0.0044, and steal v2 cap 6 +0.0032 vs v1 cap 4 +0.0058.
- v1's own SELECTION optimum shrank to +0.0019 on CONFIRMATION (l.1304-1307), which is the selection-noise signature.
- The measured quantity that is not noise, the honest pool-block OOF on the real candidate distribution, favoured v2: parent-vs-cont 0.875 vs 0.825 (44b6 0.950 / 6bba 0.859), daughter 0.743 vs 0.718.
- v2 never ran on CONFIRMATION, on x138 or on the LB.
So 'worse' is not established. The honest verdict is v1 vs v2 UNDECIDED.

WHAT CHANGED: the v1 insertion is our only mechanism with a positive public read (P27->P28, P34->P35, P38->P37, each +0.001), so the classifier behind it is the one lever that has transferred.

NEW VERDICT: STAYS CLOSED for 29 Sep, with the reason corrected.
(a) R8 (27 Sep 12:00Z). There is no x138 lab: v2 p for the x138 candidates needs a GPU kdn-score by fold, and only v1 ensemble p sits in the exp60/exp64 dumps. There is no dummy and no user OK.
(b) Swapping needs a new ensemble-threshold calibration (the v1 0.5 OOF ~ 0.4 ensemble map, l.1327). That is a knob fitted by eligible-count matching, i.e. a threshold neighbour that L5v2/I-310 exclude.
(c) It would be class C. The finals hedge is built around the proven v1 config.
(d) The ceiling is about one public division event (~0.001).

findings.what:
I-069: D1, an OOF re-score of the exp60 insertion arms with honest labels.

OLD VERDICT: refuted. 'Not a decision input (R2 decided by LB); arms labelled IN-SAMPLE UPPER BOUND; diagnostic only if GPU idles' (FINAL_REPORT_v4 section 4; R4H-7 (b)).

WHAT CHANGED:
(1) The insertion's private sign is now load-bearing in the finals logic. R12-A3 (21:31Z) pairs by 'insertion hedge' and justifies #38 with 'the insertion (lab +0.006, P(< 0 on private) 0.10-0.15)'. That +0.006 is the exp60 IN-SAMPLE number.
(2) GPU quota is no longer binding (~22 h left), and R8 passes no other mechanism, so the old cost reason is gone.

RE-CHECK: an honest per-embryo answer is already in the record at zero cost. The v1 insertion on OOF p, old exp39 base, one CONFIRMATION run on 135 videos (CONTEXT l.1304-1307):
- +0.0019 overall, 44b6 +0.0015, 6bba +0.0021;
- TP 16 -> 20, FP 28 -> 39, so the added-fork precision is 4/15 = 0.27 (Wilson 80% [0.149, 0.431]).
The exp60 x138 in-sample arm (results.md l.13-30):
- 44b6/ALL +0.0058 (+1 TP, 0 FP);
- 6bba/ALL +0.0065 (+8 TP / +6 FP, precision 0.57).
In-sample inflation is therefore ~3x on score and ~2x on precision.
The low-J break-even is J/(1+J) = 0.125 on the 6bba lab control (J 0.143), and 0.11-0.20 for private (s_merge C03). The honest 0.27 clears it, with the 80% lower bound at about the break-even. The three public +0.001 reads come from one embryo and one mechanism, so they count as a single piece of out-of-sample evidence.

NEW VERDICT: the D1 GPU run STAYS REFUTED. Its question is answered by existing honest data, and no pair row flips on it: every row keeps #38 whenever the partner carries the insertion. The CITATION needs correcting. With the honest numbers, P(insertion < 0 on private) of 0.10-0.15 is plausible but optimistic at the edge, and 0.10-0.20 is the honest band. That strengthens the insertion hedge; it does not weaken it.
Calibration caveat for R12-A9(e): 3 of the 4 E contrasts (P27->P28, P34->P35, P38->P37) are the same insertion mechanism. H-E therefore tests 'the insertion transfers to private' far more than general lab-to-private transfer. Read it that way. There is no rule change, because the read is post-deadline calibration.
